panel.summary: 'leaves history unbound on a read-only mount' is a negative test with no positive control
panel.evidence: The test dispatches a Ctrl-z keydown on `.cm-content` of a read-only mount and asserts `store.getText()` is unchanged. Nothing in the test proves the synthetic keydown would ever have reached CodeMirror's keymap on this mount (no focus, editable=false, jsdom); the assertion also holds if the event is simply ignored for unrelated reasons, so it does not specifically demonstrate that `historyKeymap: readOnly ? [] : ...` is what suppressed the undo. It also never covers the vim read-only fall-through added in editor.ts:52-56.
